## AMD launches Helios AI platform and signals expansion into robotics

Helios and a robotics push confirm AMD is broadening its attack surface against NVDA beyond data-center GPU share; if AMD establishes credible robotics silicon, it opens a second competitive front that could compress the NVDA moat narrative over time.

- AMD unveiled the Helios AI platform, a new product targeting AI compute workloads.
- AMD is simultaneously expanding into robotics, broadening its addressable market beyond traditional compute.
- Positions AMD in direct competition with NVDA across AI compute topology and emerging robotics silicon.
- High-confidence tag; product launch is the primary signal, independent of retail-facing source.
